# UNCOVr media

> UNCOVr is a research driven media agency with a focus on collaboration and fresh thinking. We help national and local brands connect with their best prospects in a platform for learning and growth. Active since 2014, UNCOVr plans and buys media across audio, video, digital, print, outdoor, and experiential channels, serving clients from Boston, New York, Denver, and San Francisco.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2014
- Headquarters: Boston, MA (PO Box 170284, Boston, MA 02116, USA)
- Markets served: Boston, New York, Denver, San Francisco
- Services: media planning and buying across audio, video, digital, print, outdoor, and experiential channels
- Leadership: Mike LaBella (Owner / Media Research and Negotiations), Andrea Giancontieri (Digital Strategy and Activation Director)
- Notable clients: Kabbage, Grasshopper (now part of LogMeIn), Society of Grownups (a MassMutual company), Atrius Health, Northeastern University, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
- Contact: mike@uncovrmedia.com, 617.987.4242
